name: 08080 · Sewell, NJ
findings: ZIP 08080 (Sewell) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08080 (Sewell) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08080 (Sewell) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
